Erin (VP Eng): Quick follow-up from the all-hands runtime Q&A. Two short asks: 1) what's the minimally safe telemetry/alerting we need for kernel-v5 canaries? 2) any customer-facing SLAs or communication changes needed? Keep replies one-line bullets.

Devon (Runtime Lead): Telemetry: p50/p95/p99, error rate, OOMs, GPU mem high-water, and RPC retries. Emit per-model and per-hardware.

Asha (Perf Eng): Add token-cost delta and cache-hit-rate to the canary dashboards. Capture tail latency with histogram buckets (1ms,10ms,100ms,1s).

Sam (SRE): Alerts: p99 > baseline*1.30 for 5m, errors > 0.5% for 3m, and OOM spikes. Auto-rollback hook enabled.

Devon (Runtime Lead): Customer comms: no SLA changes. Notify Dedicated/Private customers of opt-in canary windows and provide a rollback contact.

Erin (VP Eng): Ops question: who owns rollback?

Sam (SRE): SRE owns automated rollback. Runtime team approves manual rollbacks for model-level issues.

Asha (Perf Eng): Quick note: Redwood Optimize recommendations must be gated during canaries (no automatic policy changes).

ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary/kernel-v5/243456. Auto-rollback conditions set per alerts above.

Devon (Runtime Lead): Action items: I'll add telemetry checklist to RFC; Asha will add histograms; Sam will add alert playbook. Follow-up sync Thu 11am PT.

Erin (VP Eng): Thanks. If anyone has a single-sentence blocker reply now. Otherwise we'll move to the RFC thread. End.
